name: Prehistoric Prism

angles.text: As a dwarf, recovering genuine titan relics speaks to your people's search for their makers' origins and to the Explorers' League's purpose.
As an Alliance member, your discovery enriches the scholarly collections in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers.

faq.answer: Prospector Whelgar asks you to carry the relic to Ironforge after authenticating the titan-like inscriptions on its facets in the Wetlands.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Prehistoric Prism?

aliases: who to turn in prehistoric prism
where to turn in prehistoric prism
faq.answer: You deliver the relic to High Explorer Magellas in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. He accepts it for the museum's collection.
faq.q: Where do you deliver the Prehistoric Prism?

faq.answer: The relic is an ancient, many-faceted artifact bearing the marks of the keepers. Light through its crystalline form recalls relics found in Uldaman.
faq.q: What kind of artifact is the Prehistoric Prism?

faq.answer: The Explorers' League collects and catalogs authentic relics of titan origin. High Explorer Magellas studies such artifacts to deepen understanding of ancient history.
faq.q: Why is the Hall of Explorers interested in the prism?

aliases: does uldaman relate to the prism
faq.answer: High Explorer Magellas compares the light refracted through the artifact to relics he examined on his first archaeological dig in Uldaman. He notes its keeper markings.
faq.q: How does the prism relate to Uldaman?

faq.answer: Prospector Whelgar's authentication and your recovery of the relic are to be recorded in the Explorers' League's historical archives.
faq.q: Does your name get recorded in the museum's catalogue?

sections.body: Prospector Whelgar finds a remarkable artifact while surveying the Wetlands. Keeper inscriptions cover its many facets, and he authenticates the titan-like markings. He asks you to carry it to Ironforge, where scholars can study it. Whelgar hopes the discovery enters the official catalogue, with credit given to you for recovering it and to him for authenticating it.
sections.title: An Ancient Discovery

sections.body: High Explorer Magellas receives the relic for the Explorers' League in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. The maker marks confirm its authenticity. Magellas says light through its polished facets recalls wonders from his first excavation in Uldaman. Your donation preserves the artifact for study and adds to the League's records of the titans' legacy.
sections.title: A Gift to the Museum

summary: In the Wetlands, Prospector Whelgar has found a relic marked by the keepers. He sends you to Ironforge so the Explorers' League can study the titans' legacy.
